description: Source code for HelmChartInflationGeneratorPlugin, a plugin for generating resources from Helm charts within the kustomize framework.

classes.name: HelmChartInflationGeneratorPlugin
classes.description: A plugin for generating resources from Helm charts, supporting configuration, Helm command execution, and resource parsing.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configures the plugin with provided helpers and byte-encoded configuration data.

methods.name: establishTmpDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for Helm operations if not already established.

methods.name: validateArgs
methods.description: Validates plugin arguments such as chart name, chart home, values files, and merge options.

methods.name: errIfIllegalValuesMerge
methods.description: Checks if the values merge option is valid.

methods.name: absChartHome
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the chart home directory.

methods.name: runHelmCommand
methods.description: Executes a Helm command with specified arguments and captures output.

methods.name: createNewMergedValuesFile
methods.description: Creates a new merged values file based on inline values and existing values.

methods.name: replaceValuesInline
methods.description: Replaces inline values by merging with existing values file.

methods.name: copyValuesFile
methods.description: Copies the values file to a temporary location.

methods.name: writeValuesBytes
methods.description: Writes byte data to a temporary values file.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary directories created during processing.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Main method to generate resource map from Helm chart, executing Helm commands and parsing output.

methods.name: pullCommand
methods.description: Constructs the Helm pull command based on repository and version.

methods.name: chartExistsLocally
methods.description: Checks if the Helm chart exists locally.

methods.name: markHelmGeneratedResources
methods.description: Annotates resources as generated by Helm.

methods.name: checkHelmVersion
methods.description: Verifies that Helm version is V3 or V4.
